evidence: Fixed on fix/F040 (commit 193662a, merged 9199b05): a rock cell whose drawing is foliage now shows a rock cell of its own mass (nearest face tile for walls, nearest lid for the top), and a bush cell lying at its own floor keeps its drawing, so the ash-bush rows on the plain stay scenery. The cause was not Gen3Rock alone: Route 112's red terraces are counted-relief masses (Gen3Relief) and relief/hill rock lays each member cell's own drawing on its facets, so the foliage-drawn cells' green became the wall texture (a 4 px skirt column repeating the drawing rows every course) and their tops capped the terraces with a green lid; Gen3Rock's block path had the same sampling. Gate PASS with a freshly stamped base: no new detector regions on 10 regression maps, no cell changes, 0 fallbacks. My own check of the level-7 frame: the green wall stripes and lids are gone, walls show rock 1:1, ground bushes unchanged.
